method: Reachable positions are found by a pathfinder object at scene+0x7D8 (0x4A58 bytes): 004C8920 seeds it from the worm's spot and recursively walks both ways (004C8100) with the worm's own walk routine 004F4D80, drops off ledges, and from 16 steps before a wall or hazard tries four jumps simulated by 004C7CF0. Every 16th visited spot is recorded by 004C7710 with its move stack (compressed to 5-byte [x, y, action] steps) in the AI path buffer. The AI wraps it as 004CE690 (list AI+0x20F0, fresh buffer) and 004CE730 (list AI+0x24F4, appended after the first list's paths). 004D0170/004CFD20/004CFF20 (state 0x66, body 004D0130) follow a path with walk/jump action codes. 004CED90/004CEEC0/004CEFD0 measure drowning exposure, 004CEA30 scores a spot, 004CE920 chooses one, 004CEC90 detects imminent explosions and 004F3E50 (state 0x6A) retreats from the planned impact.
